corniceGroups.evidence: strip: parapet tops of 081118 and 157650 within ~0.3 m (y 190-197 px at 40 px/m); 081118 and 087959 share every storey line
strip: eaves/cornice of 156287, 156286 and 155418 on one line at y ~275 px (14.8 m); their gables rise above it

strip: 155417's cornice under its mansard sits at y ~313 px, ~0.9 m below its neighbours' (compile pass 1 snapped it into the 1903 group and the eaves gate failed: 3DBAG 14.06 vs 14.65 m; re-read on a zoomed crop)

identical.evidence: strip: same 3-bay front, middle balconies on storeys 1-3, orange brick with cream bands, centred stepped gable; ground floors mirrored

roof.evidence: strip.jpg 2024-11-29: behind the three step/curved gables a short steep tiled attic face shows over the eaves and sky above it; nothing shows over the parapets of 081118/087959/157650; 155417 is a dark mansard with one dormer. The 3DBAG ridges and rear volumes up to 19.7 m are not on the photo (user review 2026-10-10).

notes: 2.5 m eaves step between 157650 (1908) and 156287 (1903) is on the photo: the 1903 row is a storey lower.
Pass 2 (after the first compile): 155417 moved out of the 1903 cornice group; 156287 (and its twin 155418) given stone lintels on the top storey, visible as cream slabs on the zoomed eaves crop.
